outcome: Fetal and neonatal complications (premature birth, oligohydramnios, fetal growth restriction, perinatal death, vertical transmission)
Cord blood IgG and IgM antibodies
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth at Rouhani Hospital, Iran, between September 2020 and September 2021, divided into SARS-CoV-2 infected and non-infected groups.
finding: Neonates born to mothers with COVID-19 faced significantly higher risks of cesarean delivery, NICU admission, preterm birth, and low 5-minute APGAR scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common among women with COVID-19 compared to non-infected pregnant women.
